title: New Releases: KR Tribal Fort Tileset , Winlu Fantasy Exterior Add-on Farm Tiles + Winlu and KR Updates

posts.author: RPGMakerWeb
posts.body:
Two new tilesets for RPG Maker! A new Tribal Fort set from Kokoro Reflections! A new Farm Add-on for Winlu Fantasy!
​
Build a protected village for your orc heroine to live in with the KR Tribal Fort Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a MV/MZ-sized tileset ready to help you build wooden huts and thick log walls to keep the village safe from deadly monsters and dangerous adventurers! A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 5 B sheets are ready to build exteriors and interiors filled with all the spikes, skulls, and weaponry an orc could wish for. Create buildings with wooden logs tied together with ropes and decorated with bones, and mark the chief’s home with draped red cloth off its roof. Create arenas for the villagers to train in with curved walls of logs, or mark combat areas with large curved bone and set up an armory hut filled with gnarly weapons nearby so fights are always fair. Let your heroes recover in rooms with roughly hammered together shelves and beds made from animal hides, and lock troublemakers up in wooden cages!
This pack also includes character sprites for log gates, a wooden treasure chest, a cloth curtain to use as a door, and rotating meat that you can set up over a campfire. Reward your players patience by having the raw meat they stick over the fire turn into a stat-boosting roasted meal, and stop your players from leaving the village too early by keeping the massive wooden gates firmly closed until they’re properly equipped. If your orc heroine needs a strong place to call home, or you want to give your adventurers a new place to challenge orcs and goblins, pick up the KR Tribal Fort Tileset!

​
Give your players a lovely farm to run when they’re not off adventuring with the Winlu Fantasy Exterior Add-on Farm Tiles pack! Winlu is back with another addition to their Fantasy Exterior series, this time focusing on healthy plants and rustic charm to turn any houses you’ve already built into a working farm. 1 B sheet includes wood and thatch angled roofs to build barns, and short stone walls to keep your wheat fields separate from your livestock. Chicken coops and feed troughs are perfect for keeping your animals fed and safe, and some scattered piles of hay can add to the feeling that this is a busy farm with a working windmill.
And once you’ve set up the map, add more life to your farm with this pack’s character sprites! Have white and brown cows wander a grassy field where they can be milked, and give pigs some treats in the hopes of them digging up some useful items. Chickens can offer eggs (just watch out for the aggressive rooster!), and swarms of bees can be carefully followed back to their hive to gather healing honey. If animals aren’t your hero’s focus, then fill the fields with wheat, corn, and sunflowers that all grow and await harvesting. Smaller plots can grow carrots, cabbages, turnips, grapes, pumpkins, and tomatoes that your heroes could sell for extra cash, and let your heroes smash the rocks that appear in the fields to possibly find gold or silver ore. Pick up the Winlu Fantasy Exterior Add-on Farm Tiles pack and add some money-making farms to your towns and villages!
